name: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed
summary: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed - a premium screed that is easy to apply with good working time, but also reaches a high strength with low moisture within 24hrs.
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed - a premium screed that is easy to apply with good working time, but also reaches a high strength with low moisture within 24hrs.
usage: Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed is applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges Applications are as follows > Internal & external space > Bonded screed from 10mm - 100mm > Un-bonded screed from 30mm - 80mm
advantages: ▪ Pre-mixed binder with selected aggregates ▪ High strength – ~40MPa after 28 days ▪ Good working time 20-30min @ 23°C ▪ Low shrinkage ▪ Tiles may be installed after 15hrs ▪ Suitable for all residential or commercial flooring installation

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Complies with the requirements noted in
Section 1.3.12 & 3.3 of AS 1884:2021
Floor Coverings - Resilient sheet and tiles - Installation practices

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 12 months in a cool, dry and weatherproof environment.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Bags must be stored off the floor. Avoid sitting bags in direct sunlight prior to application.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Bonded Screed | Un-bonded Screed
Lankolatex 751 & GP cement mixed 1:1 | Polyethylene sheet
Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed | Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed
Subsequent suitable materials | Subsequent suitable materials

items.label: Compressive strength
items.text: ~22 MPa at 1 day ~40 MPa at 28 days

items.label: Reaction to fire
items.text: No hazardous combustion products are known

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text: Allow 15 hours at 23°C prior to the application of tile or levelling systems. Allow 3 days at 23°C for impervious floor coverings or membranes. Drying is dependent on thickness of application, temperature, air flow & relative humidity. Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text: Mixing can be undertaken with: ▪ Slow speed mixing drill & pail ▪ Cement mixer ▪ Forced drum mixer For best results a forced drum mixer or cement mixer is advised.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Slowly add powder to the clean cool water and mix for a continuous 2-3 minutes. A semi-dry consistency must be achieved, but will form when pressure is applied. Install mixed product immediately. Not mixing for the recommended time or additional water may result in product irregularities and possible product failure.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Bonded Screed Application 10mm - 100mm For bonded screed applications a Bond/Slurry coat must first be applied prior to placement of Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed.Bonded screeds above 50mm must have galvanized wire installed as per AS 3958.1.
Un-bonded Screeds Application: 30 - 80mm Lay 2 layers of polyethylene film on the substrate and tape the joins. Place the mixed Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed onto the polyethelene film and reinforce with galvanized wire as per AS 3958.1. Screed to falls and desired heights should be created during this process. Bond/Slurry coat is Lankolatex 751/GP cement mixed 1:1 by ratio. Apply Bond/Slurry coat to the substrate with a stiff broom making sure adequate slurry is observed on the surface. While the Bond /Slurry coat is still wet and tacky apply the Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed and compact (tamp). Screed to falls and desired heights should be created during this process. Note: Should the Bond/ Slurry coat skin prior to placement of Sikafloor®-215 Rapid Screed, remove and replace prior to further product being installed.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and equipment with warm water and detergent while the product is still wet.
